language: calibration and proper scores only (Brier, log loss, intervals); no edge, profit, ROI or money figure

seal.rule: committed ALONE on its own day; never the day of another identity change (not 10-06 consolidated seal A, not 10-07 commit B, not the S644 PREREG_R2 day, not the S721 day); preseason rehearsal 10-12..10-14 to scratch first
seal.missed_hard_limit: the log starts the listing day after the seal lands; earlier rows are never counted
seal.pin: a test helper in the style of tests/platformkit/execution/s469_seal_helper.py asserts the file sha256

families.scope: every ESPN-listed NBA game of listing day D with season.type 2 or 3 (ingame/nba_season_type.season_of); preseason, All-Star, exhibitions and non-canon teams excluded and counted; no selection

probability_source.parameters: as in the file: K 20, HFA 60, init 1500, 538 MOV multiplier, no season regression
probability_source.method: scratch root espn_boxscores.parquet = base + backfill + season rows dated < D, D's games appended as placeholder rows (110-100), p read for the appended rows; refuse duplicate_team_on_day

implementation_sha256_candidates_2026_10._rule: sha256 of LF-normalized bytes (raw.replace(CRLF, LF), as s469_seal_helper.py:46) = sha256 of the git blob content; test_*.py excluded; S782b/S782c files join at seal; the seal cut re-reads every value (S782a r2 candidates on cxp/S782a-2026-10-06-r2)

data_pins.backfill_rows: 9 final games 2026-05-25..2026-06-13 (built 2026-10-06 S782a adoption; byte-identical rebuild; the seal cut re-reads the sha)

probability_source.prior_measurement: retrospective holdout n=372: Brier 0.1735 vs proportional sportsbook close 0.1672, gap +0.0063, 95% CI [-0.0042, +0.0168], DM p 0.237, MATCHES_CLOSE, MDE 0.0150, underpowered (docs/evidence/pregame/DM_RECOMPUTE_2026-09-24.md)

cut.cut_ts: min(D 15:00:00Z, T1 - 120 min); T1 = earliest scheduled_start of D's in-scope games
cut.inputs_allowed: box finals dated < D, the schedule response for D; no odds, no venue price, no injury or lineup feed
cut.resources: one child, peak RSS <= 300 MB, wall <= 120 s

families.reason: measured forecaster TRAILS_CLOSE (+0.0039, CI [+0.0028, +0.0051]); its outcome corpus is the sportsbookreviewsonline archive (LICENCE_LEDGER row 13 UNREAD) and the served games_current.parquet is frozen at 2026-07-12; postseason only, cannot reach the floor before the season ends
families.join_rule: sealed amendment before its first row

families.reason: no forecaster measured against a close (scripts/platformkit/nfl_game_model.py is an unmeasured baseline; nflverse not in the licence ledger)
families.join_rule: sealed amendment before its first row

families.reason: the measured soccer row is O/U 2.5, not the Kalshi three-way winner market; no measured 1X2 forecaster
families.join_rule: sealed amendment before its first row

comparator.primary: devigged Kalshi mid at the SAME cut_ts
comparator.source: data/cache/ingame_books_local/kalshi/nba/<UTC day>.jsonl, record_type snapshot_bulk or snapshot, series KXNBAGAME, both side tickers of the event
comparator.row_rule: newest row with capture_ts <= cut_ts and age <= 1800 s; two-sided 0 < yes_bid < yes_ask < 1; spread <= 0.10; mid = (yes_bid + yes_ask) / 2
comparator.secondary: same rule at the last capture before scheduled_start (the close); own cell, never pooled with the primary
comparator.note: the prior n=372 measurement used a sportsbook close, not a Kalshi mid

outcome.cross_check: docs/evidence/forward/scoreboard/<D>.json settlement where the same ticker was served; disagreement = OUTCOME_CONFLICT

scoring.paired_difference: d_i = loss_model - loss_comparator, one row per game
scoring.test: scripts/platformkit/eval_gate/dm_test.py diebold_mariano(d, cluster_ids=game_key), Student-t G-1, 95 pct
scoring.sensitivity: date-clustered (cluster = listing day D); a different verdict appends 'verdict sensitive to clustering'
also_reported: LATE, UNWITNESSED, EDITED, NO_MID, UNLINKED, OUTCOME_* counts
scoring.cells: sport x family x comparator; (a) the ISO week, descriptive only; (b) cumulative since effective_from

floor.below_floor: INSUFFICIENT with n, MDE and projected MDE-0.01 date

scoring.beats_guard: a BEATS reading is written to the file; its public sentence waits for a cv-honesty-gate pass (inputs_as_of leak audit, exclusion audit) and is never phrased as an edge or in money
scoring.byte_identity: a rerun over the same inputs writes identical bytes

when_model_trails: published in full in the same week's file and the same one-liner template, with the appended sentence: 'The market mid is sharper than this ratings-only model by <g> Brier; expected, the model sees no injury, rest or lineup information.'
